note: P is the same dark iOS-style 4x5 calculator four times (only the accent colour and button tint shift). Q ranges from a light peach theme to a dark outlined blue one, a cream and green one, and a seven-segment LCD pocket calculator with a wide equals key and a different layout. R is more mixed: an LCD with a history side panel, a dark iOS look, a cream iOS look and a light-green LCD with a Backspace bar, but several share the same layout. R2's history panel goes beyond basic, so R breaks one; the use frames show the arithmetic working in the others.
